name: The Close — Freelance Client Proposal & Contract Suite (Canva Template)
description:
Win High-Ticket Retainers & Projects with an Institutional Proposal

Stop sending unformatted emails or generic estimates. The Close is an 8-page, modern client proposal and service agreement suite designed for freelance developers, UI/UX designers, marketing agencies, and consultants who pitch - + projects.

💎 What Is Included:

  • 8 Complete Business Proposal Pages: Project Overview & Objectives, Scope of Work & Deliverables, Detailed Milestones & Project Timeline, 3-Tiered Investment Options (Starter, Growth, Enterprise), Case Study & Social Proof, Client Onboarding Roadmap, Terms of Service & Payment Terms, and Client Sign-off Page.
  • Executive Aesthetic: Deep navy and slate typography engineered to look authoritative and premium.
  • 1-Click Instant Canva Access: Easily change logos, brand colors, project scope, and rates in Canva Free or Pro.
  • Printable & Digital Ready: Export to PDF for digital client e-signatures or physical printouts.
  • Pre-Written Scope & Legal Boilerplate: Realistic copy prompts for scope boundaries and revision clauses.
  • Lifetime Free Updates: All future additions and proposal formats included.

🛠️ How It Works:

  1. Instant download upon checkout.
  2. Open the Access-Your-Template.html file to copy the suite to your Canva workspace.
  3. Customize the scope and pricing tiers to match your proposal, and export as PDF to send to your client!
